title: Ultimate Tester test plan
description: How Tess tests this app. Committed to the repo and shared with the team. Nothing here belongs to one Mac: no passwords, sessions, keys or folder paths. Fields marked x-ask are ones Tess can't work out from the repo; setup asks the person once and writes the answer here.

browser.description: true: Tess uses the app in a browser (it can still send requests to its API). false: the app has no pages; Tess tests it with requests only and no browser opens.

command.description: Starts the app locally. Must contain {port}: Tess replaces it with a free port for each run, so her copy never collides with yours.

port.description: The app's usual port, used when a person starts it by hand and in examples.

cwd.description: Folder to run the command in, relative to the repo root. Defaults to the root.

readyUrl.description: Answers with a 2xx once the app is up. Always local and on {port}; a health route for an API.

readySeconds.description: How long the first start may take before Tess gives up.

env.description: Extra settings for the start command. Never secrets: the engine refuses names ending in KEY, SECRET, TOKEN or PASSWORD. Secrets come from the app's own env file.

seed.description: Resets local test data before a run, or null when there is nothing to reset. Always a command, never prose.

allowed.description: Hosts Tess may open or call besides her own copy of the app (which is always allowed), e.g. a dev storefront.

never.description: Hosts Tess must never open or call, e.g. production.
never.x-ask: Are there production addresses I must never open or call?

neverRun.description: Commands Tess must never run, matched by how they start ("git push" blocks "git push origin main").

personas.description: Each kind of user (or, for an app with no browser, each kind of caller) whose access differs. Tess tests as each one.

who.description: Plain words, as a person would say it.

signIn.description: saved: a person signs in as them once per Mac and the session stays on that Mac. signUp: Tess creates a fresh account each run (see signUp). none: no sign-in.
signIn.x-ask: How should I get in as this person: an account you sign in to once on each Mac, a fresh account I create each run, or no sign-in?

url.description: Sign-up page path on Tess's copy of the app.

email.description: Test email; {time} becomes the run time so each account is new.

mustNeverBreak.description: Core things people do every day. Tess checks every one on every test.
mustNeverBreak.x-ask: What must never break, whatever changes?

check.description: What should work, in plain words.

as.description: Persona key to do it as. Leave out when anyone can.

startAt.description: Path to start from, on Tess's copy of the app.

ownTests.description: The repo's own tests that Tess runs alongside her checks: only the test files a change adds or edits. Never whole suites; that is CI's job and would take too long.

command.description: Runs one test file; {file} becomes its path.

backends.description: Other apps this one calls. When you test this app, Tess starts your local copy of each first, from its own plan, and points this app at it.

name.description: Short tag shown on checks, e.g. core-api.

repo.description: Git remote as host/owner/name, no scheme or credentials, so any Mac can find its checkout.

env.description: The setting in this app that holds the backend's address. Tess sets it to her local copy's address.

whenMissing.description: dev: use the address already in the env file and say so in the result. stop: don't test without the local copy.
whenMissing.x-ask: If this backend isn't on a Mac, should I use the dev one or stop?

notes.description: What Tess should always keep in mind: things to focus on, skip, or that look broken but aren't. Written by people.

lessons.description: Corrections people gave on past results. Tess adds these; people can remove them.

environment.description: Test data Tess made before and exactly how, so she can recreate it after the local data is reset. Tess adds these.

allOf.description: An app with no browser has callers, not people who sign in: keys come from its env file.

repoPath.description: Relative to the repo root; no leading slash, no ..

hostPattern.description: A host, optionally with a leading *. for any subdomain and an optional scheme or port. No paths.
